EpisodeTiming.description:
When an episode of one behaviour starts and ends (coach/metrics/episodes.py). The thresholds are the
coaching rules' own (config.pose), so tuning.json tunes both.

min_on_s.description: The condition must hold this long before an episode starts (the episode's start time is when it began to hold).
min_on_s.title: Min On S

min_off_s.description: The condition must be clear this long before an episode ends (the episode's end time is when it was last seen).
min_off_s.title: Min Off S

EpisodeTiming.title: EpisodeTiming

EpisodesConfig.description:
Behaviour episodes: every occurrence with a start and an end, for the run record and the replay of
moments. Separate from the coaching rules, which are throttled for live feedback.

unknown_grace_s.description: An open episode survives this long without a usable measure (occlusion, tracking loss); after that it ends with end_reason 'tracking_lost'.
unknown_grace_s.title: Unknown Grace S

EpisodesConfig.title: EpisodesConfig

fresh_max_age_s.description: Samples older than this are not 'fresh'.

calibration_s.description: Default quiet calibration duration for the session reference.

min_reference_samples.description: Fresh samples needed for a session reference.

rise_threshold_bpm.description: Above-reference threshold for the observation rule.

min_fresh_samples.description: Fresh samples in the window required to evaluate.

target_rate_hz.description: Advisory pose observation rate for devices.

stale_after_s.description: A pose frame older than this is not 'current'.

reset_after_gap_s.description: Smoothing restarts after a gap this long.

reference_window_s.description: Window for the median torso-length reference.
reference_window_s.title: Reference Window S

reorder_tolerance_s.description: Older frames than this are stored but not smoothed.
reorder_tolerance_s.title: Reorder Tolerance S

hand_movement_high_per_s.description: Rule body.hand_movement_high: faster wrist (torso lengths/s, relative to the torso) is 'high'.
hand_movement_high_per_s.title: Hand Movement High Per S

hand_movement_clear_per_s.description: Hysteresis: the faster wrist must drop below this to re-arm the rule.
hand_movement_clear_per_s.title: Hand Movement Clear Per S

torso_movement_high_per_s.description: Rule body.torso_movement_high: torso-center speed (torso lengths/s) above this is 'high'.
torso_movement_high_per_s.title: Torso Movement High Per S

torso_movement_clear_per_s.description: Hysteresis: torso-center speed must drop below this to re-arm the rule.
torso_movement_clear_per_s.title: Torso Movement Clear Per S

posture_window_s.description: Posture measures are medians over this window (one noisy frame does not count; adds about half of it as delay).
posture_window_s.title: Posture Window S

arms_crossed_min_cross.description: Rule body.arms_crossed: both wrists at least this far past the body midline, towards the other side (torso lengths).
arms_crossed_min_cross.title: Arms Crossed Min Cross

arms_crossed_clear_cross.description: Hysteresis: re-arms once a wrist is back to the midline (score below this).
arms_crossed_clear_cross.title: Arms Crossed Clear Cross

arms_crossed_min_height.description: Crossed wrists must be at least this low on the torso (0 = shoulder line, 1 = hip line).
arms_crossed_min_height.title: Arms Crossed Min Height

arms_crossed_max_height.description: ... and at most this low (hands crossed in front of the hips do not count).
arms_crossed_max_height.title: Arms Crossed Max Height

arms_crossed_max_reach.description: Wrists further than this from the body midline (torso lengths) are not folded arms.
arms_crossed_max_reach.title: Arms Crossed Max Reach

face_touch_max_distance.description: Rule body.face_touch: nearest wrist within this distance of a face point (nose, eyes, ears), in torso lengths. 2D: a hand in front of the face counts too.
face_touch_max_distance.title: Face Touch Max Distance

face_touch_clear_distance.description: Hysteresis: the nearest wrist must move further than this from the face to re-arm.
face_touch_clear_distance.title: Face Touch Clear Distance

looking_down_min_delta.description: Rule body.looking_down: head pitch (nose below the ear line, torso lengths) at least this much above the head-up reference (~0.06 = about 20 degrees of head tilt).
looking_down_min_delta.title: Looking Down Min Delta

looking_down_clear_delta.description: Hysteresis: head pitch must come back within this of the reference to re-arm.
looking_down_clear_delta.title: Looking Down Clear Delta

head_pitch_reference_window_s.description: Window for the head-up reference (adapts to camera height and the person).
head_pitch_reference_window_s.title: Head Pitch Reference Window S

head_pitch_reference_percentile.description: Head-up reference = this percentile of head pitch over the window (low = most 'up'; works while the head is up at least this % of the time).
head_pitch_reference_percentile.title: Head Pitch Reference Percentile

head_pitch_reference_min_s.description: The reference needs this much history (s) before the rule can evaluate.
head_pitch_reference_min_s.title: Head Pitch Reference Min S

sustain_s.description: Condition must hold this long before firing.
sustain_s.title: Sustain S

cooldown_s.description: Minimum time before the same rule may fire again.

target_wpm_max.description: Practice target: speaking rate above this is 'fast'.

rate_clear_margin_wpm.description: Hysteresis: rate must fall this far below target.

min_words_for_rate.description: Fewer final words in the window -> rate unavailable.

long_pause_s.description: Silence between speech segments counted as a long pause.
long_pause_s.title: Long Pause S
